decisions.reason: The candidate's existing message-35 INTRODUCE already records the category label's placement before the author name and photo, so no additional or incomplete MODIFY exists.
The source changes placement of the combined author identity relative to the category label; it does not change the independently recorded photo shape or size.
Category and author placement does not alter the Dorian Vale article's color restriction or the reservation of red for the cover.
Using the site to determine an article's category does not change the existing requirement to source article content from the website.
The article category and author placement decision does not affect the issue date or edition metadata.
The source decision does not change the deferred print-ready deliverable, resolution, or prepress settings.
A visually suitable category label is a category-label-specific constraint and does not modify the existing overall polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style.
The article metadata placement decision does not change the digital flipbook PDF deliverable.
The source decision does not alter the requirement to enhance publication images when necessary.
Using the Flat Plan to determine article categories does not replace or modify the existing Flat Plan reference for overall issue structure.
The source decision adds article-level metadata placement but does not change the requirement to create a magazine layout template.
